title: KC & The Sunshine Band - Please Don’t Go [Xw]

I've had one dream come true

Don't go, I'm begging you to stay

The minute you walk out that door
So please don't go, don't go, don't go away, hey, hey, hey, I need your love, I'm out on my knees,
